Definition: from the same as G3804; liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain:--suffer.
BiblicalUsage: Pathetos means liable to suffer, doomed to experience pain. It appears once, in Acts 26:23, where Paul says the prophets and Moses said Christ should suffer, and that He should be the first that should rise from the dead.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Christ who should suffer is the Christ the prophets promised, and His suffering was not an accident but the appointment of God.
